title: The Advance Booking Share Taken Off an Equipment Rental and Demo Hire Rate
content:
Kit reserved well before the collection date lets the shop plan its stock, and the hire rate on an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement carries an advance booking share off for it, at its full figure or at half of it according to how long the agreement runs.

## The rule

Where the reservation was recorded at least the package's advance booking period in days before the collection date, and the agreement runs for at least the package's multi-day threshold in days, the package's advance booking share is taken off last of the three.

Where the reservation was recorded at least that period before the collection date but the agreement runs for fewer days than that threshold, half the package's advance booking share is taken off last of the three.

In any other case no share is taken off under this heading.

## The package figures this rule reads

| Package | Advance booking period, days | Multi-day threshold, days | Advance booking share | Half of it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 7 | 3 | 15 per cent | 7.5 per cent |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 7 | 3 | 15 per cent | 7.5 per cent |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 7 | 3 | 12.5 per cent | 6.25 per cent |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 10 | 3 | 10 per cent | 5 per cent |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 10 | 2 | 10 per cent | 5 per cent |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 30 | 1 | 0 per cent | 0 per cent |

## The two conditions in combination

| Recorded at least the advance period before the collection date | The agreement runs for at least the multi-day threshold | Share taken off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | the package's advance booking share |
| yes | no | half the package's advance booking share |
| no | either way | none under this heading |

A lead exactly equal to the package's advance period meets the first test, and a length exactly equal to the package's threshold meets the second.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical agreement

Take a Basic Ski & Board Rental agreement standing at 200.00 USD when this heading is reached, whose advance period is 7 days and whose threshold is 3 days.

- Recorded 12 days before the collection date and running for 5 days: 15 per cent comes off, leaving 170.00 USD.
- Recorded 12 days before the collection date and running for 2 days: 7.5 per cent comes off, leaving 185.00 USD.
- Recorded 4 days before the collection date: no share is taken off under this heading.

## Point of judgement

**How the lead is measured.** It is the calendar days from the date the reservation was recorded to the collection date on the agreement.
